# allierays.com — Full Content Index

> Allie Rays — building AI tools that make one person as effective as a team.

Personal blog about Applied AI, building real tools, and what works when shipping AI in production.

## Author

Allie Rays — Lead Enterprise PreSales Engineer at Go1. Building Applied AI tools and platforms. MIT Applied Agentic AI. Four hackathon wins including 1st place at the Redis MCP AI Agents Hackathon and top 30 at Anthropic's Build with Claude.

## Posts

- [Agentic Workflows, Agents, and Multi-Agent Systems](/posts/agents-vs-workflows): From fully controlled to fully autonomous. How to pick the right pattern.
- [5 Techniques to Debug Claude Code](/posts/5-techniques-to-debug-claude-code): When Claude is failing, the problem is context, not intelligence. Here are the five techniques I actually use to get unstuck.
- [Can We Teach AI Agents Integrity?](/posts/can-we-teach-ai-agents-integrity): I scored 13,000 AI agent messages for integrity, compassion, and accuracy. Here's what I found and the system I built to measure character using Aristotle's framework.
- [If You're Not Using the Ralph Loop, You Become Your Own Loop](/posts/agentic-loop-ci-cd-for-ai-coding): Think of it like CI/CD for AI coding. You plan in one terminal, Ralph codes autonomously in the other.
- [How We Won the MCP Hackathon with PitchScoop](/posts/how-we-won-mcp-hackathon-with-pitchscoop): First place at the MCP AI Agents Hackathon. 32 MCP tools, Redis Sorted Sets for live leaderboards, and a dual-interface architecture built in 7 hours.
- [I Built an AI Agent That QAs Our Demos So We Don't Have To](/posts/ai-audit-agent-storylane): An AI-powered QA tool that scrapes Storylane demos, reviews every step for grammar, messaging, and GTM alignment, and gives you a scored report.
- [Transforming Project Management Data into Business Intelligence](/posts/data-driven-process-improvements): How I connected Asana, Salesforce, and Domo through APIs to turn scattered project data into automated dashboards.
